blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Senate impeachment court on Tuesday served a subpoena to Davao City Mayor Sebastian “Baste” Duterte to appear as the prosecution panel’s witness in the impeachment trial of her sister, Vice President Sara Duterte. Two members of the Senate Office of the Sergeant-at-Arms personally went to Davao City to serve the subpoena
